description: VEST Tier A confinement table (Lane D, #548): one row per magnetics state key of state key contract v1 (#1454), built by workflow/confinement_scaling/build_table.py; repo-only derived sample, not shipped in the wheel.

source.criteria: Lane K state.csv regenerated under criteria v2 (#1521): efit_quality is fit quality only; thomson_consistent is the [1, 2] p_e verdict

assumptions.dip_dt: local quadratic fit over 0.001 s of the measured Ip
assumptions.dwdt: local degree-1 fit over 0.003 s of W_mhd on the shot's labelled (good/admissible) EFIT slices only; NaN with one labelled slice, where dli_3/dt is unavailable too (likewise at labelled slices further apart than the window) and l_i is held fixed in V_ind there, so P_OH and R_p are still computed
assumptions.external_inductance: flux between the inboard loop and the LCFS is not removed
assumptions.m_eff_amu: 1.0 (H+ per state key contract v1; not measured)
assumptions.p_ohm: I_p,meas * (V_loop,meas - (1/I_p) dW_int/dt), W_int = mu0 R0 li_3 I_p^2/4 (Romero 2010 eq. 24)
assumptions.p_rad: not measured (no bolometer mapping): NaN; P_transport undefined
assumptions.tau_e_kin: W_kin of the paired electron_kinetic state over the magnetics P_net: its dW/dt is dW_mhd/dt, since a single kinetic slice per shot has no rate of its own
assumptions.v_loop: inboard-midplane flux loop, mean over 0.0005 s

n_e_definition: z = 0 chord inside the LCFS through the Thomson core_profiles n_e(rho_tor_norm) at the EFIT time (vaft.data.public, Lane M); NaN without a TS profile at that time
p_loss_definition: P_net = P_OH - dW/dt, P_OH = I_p V_res from the measured inboard loop voltage minus the internal inductive voltage; radiation NOT subtracted (as DB5 PLTH); no auxiliary heating
w_th_definition: W_mhd = 1.5 int p dV of the magnetics EFIT (statistical_891); W_kin (electron_kinetic EFIT) in w_kin_J; W_e = 1.5 int p_e dV of the Thomson fit alone in w_e_ts_J
tau_e_definition: W_mhd / P_net; W_mhd = 1.5 int p dV of the magnetics EFIT; tau_e_kin_s = W_kin / P_net with the same (W_mhd) dW/dt
b_t_definition: vacuum field |b0 r0| / r_geo_m, as DB5 BT
m_eff_source: assumed H+ (state key contract v1), not measured
source_database: VAFT Lane D Tier A confinement table (#548)
source_reference: VEST Tier A #1331, EFIT statistical_891, state key contract v1 #1454

dropped_columns.efit_product_sha256: per row in the atlas table

series: per-shot power balance on the labelled EFIT slices (atlas series/<shot>.csv) for 39915 (block 399xx-403xx) and 42894 (block 429xx-430xx); 39917 and 42962 are the #1905 reference regressions (reference_inputs)
caveat: 429xx-430xx block (criteria v2, #1521): 2 of 80 state keys are fit-quality good; 84 % of its Thomson-matched slices are Thomson-inconsistent (48 % for 399xx-403xx); it is 1.6x denser (2.7x in the primary selection). At fixed I_p and I_p V_loop its W_mhd is x1.8 the 399xx block's; with density included the offset is +0.01 +- 0.12 (log) on Thomson-consistent state keys (only 5 of them in 429xx) and +0.37 +- 0.09 on inconsistent ones. On the primary selection the consistent offset stays (+0.61 +- 0.27, 4 slices), and the Thomson-only W_e of the inconsistent 429xx slices is low (log offset -1.3), so the disagreement is not one-sided. A block-wide magnetics-EFIT bias is not decided by Tier A. See #1490.

selection.status: primary selection decided 2026-10-02 on #1490; accepted/selected apply it; the sensitivity set is fit.py SELECTIONS['sensitivity']; threshold_sweep.csv gives the count on a grid

reference_inputs.description: Frozen per-slice inputs of the #1905 reference regressions: the atlas series/<shot>.csv of the same 2026-10-02 build as vest_tier_a_confinement.csv (labelled magnetics EFIT slices only). test/test_confinement_power_balance.py re-derives V_ind, V_res, P_OH, dW/dt, P_net and tau_E from the ip_meas_A, dip_dt_A_s, v_loop_V, li_3 and w_mhd_J columns with vaft.process.confinement.ohmic_confinement_series.

settings.dip_dt: local quadratic fit over 0.001 s of the measured Ip (already applied in dip_dt_A_s)

42962.reference: H_89 at 0.333 s (thomson_consistent=False: a numerical reference only)

reference_inputs.r0: vaft.omas.update.resolve_reference_major_radius of the magnetics EFIT product (verified 2026-10-11; product sha256 unchanged since the 2026-10-02 build)
